meta.description: Prepare journal manuscripts, conference papers, research posters, and grant documents using venue-specific formatting guidance and bundled LaTeX scaffolds. Use when selecting an official template, checking current page or anonymity rules, adapting academic writing to a venue, or inspecting a submission PDF.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; documentation emphasizes verification of current venue rules and clear distinction between official templates and generic scaffolds

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for formatting and template selection; excellent boundaries requiring official source verification and prohibiting stale information

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established academic publishing standards with explicit references to official author instructions and style guides

code_usability.detail: Helper scripts are syntactically correct with clear parameter documentation; LaTeX scaffolds follow standard conventions

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage including journals, conferences, grants, posters with verification workflow, bundled scaffolds (11 LaTeX files), helper scripts (3 utilities), and 11 reference files

reliability.note: Excellent mandatory currency rule requiring official source verification with date recording; clear scaffold vs official template distinctions; minor: lacks explicit guidance on handling conflicting requirements

performance_context.note: Well-structured documentation (270 lines) with clear 5-step verification workflow, comprehensive reference map, and organized asset inventory

agent_usability.note: Exceptional mandatory currency rule (5-step verification); clear when-to-use guidance; comprehensive workflow for each document type; strong scaffold status documentation

human_usability.note: Clear installation requirements (Python 3.11+, optional LaTeX/Poppler); workflow examples for each document type; helper scripts for querying, customizing, and validating; final compliance checklist

security.note: Good practices for blind review (anonymity checking, metadata removal); LaTeX escaping mentioned for user text; minor: could add more explicit guidance on embedded metadata removal from PDFs

maintainability.note: Outstanding structure with version 1.2, license (MIT), comprehensive reference organization (11 files), explicit asset inventory with status, maintenance section with review date (2026-07-20)

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with LaTeX toolchain; clear integration with official templates; comprehensive reference structure; minor: validation script capabilities could be more explicitly documented

recommendations.title: Add comprehensive validation script capability documentation
recommendations.problem: Validation script can check page count and fonts but other capabilities/limitations not fully documented
recommendations.root_cause: Users need to know what compliance checks are automated vs manual
recommendations.fix: Add section: 'PDF Validation Capabilities: CAN check: total pages, content-section pages (if --content-pages specified), embedded fonts. CANNOT check: margin compliance, font sizes within document, line spacing, hidden metadata, anonymization, required sections, figure quality. Manual review required for these.'

recommendations.title: Strengthen scaffold warnings in descriptions
recommendations.problem: Status column marks scaffolds but descriptions could be more prominent
recommendations.root_cause: Users skimming tables may miss status distinction
recommendations.fix: Prepend scaffold descriptions with '⚠️ GENERIC SCAFFOLD (NOT OFFICIAL):' and change official templates to '✓ OFFICIAL:' for visual distinction. Example: '⚠️ GENERIC SCAFFOLD: Nature-oriented writing scaffold; not an official Nature template'

recommendations.title: Add skill staleness guidance
recommendations.problem: Review date documented but no guidance on when information becomes unreliable
recommendations.root_cause: Annual conference details change yearly; users need freshness indicators
recommendations.fix: Add to maintenance: 'Conference snapshots are reliable for their labeled year only. After July of year N+1, treat year N conference details as historical reference—verify all requirements with current official sources. Journal and grant guidance has longer validity but always verify current solicitations.'

recommendations.title: Add explicit PDF metadata removal guidance
recommendations.problem: Anonymity checking mentioned but metadata removal not explicit
recommendations.root_cause: PDFs can contain author names in metadata even when document is anonymized
recommendations.fix: Add to security/anonymity section: 'For blind review, check PDF metadata: use `exiftool paper.pdf` or PDF viewer properties. Remove author, institution, and file path metadata. Many LaTeX compilers embed this by default. Use `exiftool -all= paper.pdf` or re-export with metadata stripping.'
